record.paper_title: Boundary and Defect CFT: Open Problems and Applications
record.original_question: Can the bootstrap analysis of conformal field theories on real projective space be extended to holographic or otherwise strongly coupled theories such as N = 4 super Yang-Mills theory or Liouville theory, and if so does it agree with the corresponding holographic predictions?

evidence.quote: In the future, it would be interesting to study holographic models such as N = 4 super Yang-Mills theory or Liouville theory and compare them with the holographic predictions.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a conformal field theory on the real projective space $\mathbb{RP}^d$, viewed as the quotient of $S^d$ (or equivalently $\mathbb{R}^d \cup \{\infty\}$) by the antipodal involution. On such a non-orientable background, one-point functions of bulk primary operators are generically nonzero and two-point functions admit a crossing equation derived by comparing the bulk OPE channel with the image (mirror) channel through the parity-identification. This setup defines the "$\mathbb{RP}^d$ bootstrap" for CFT data $\{a_\mathcal{O}\}$ (one-point coefficients) and operator dimensions.

Problem: Extend the $\mathbb{RP}^d$ crossing/bootstrap analysis to strongly coupled or holographic conformal field theories — in particular to four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory on $\mathbb{RP}^4$ (with an appropriate $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauging including charge conjugation) and to two-dimensional Liouville theory on $\mathbb{RP}^2$. Determine the one-point functions and the two-point functions of half-BPS (respectively primary) operators on $\mathbb{RP}^d$ in these theories, and compare the results with the predictions obtained from the dual gravitational/holographic description (for $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM, type IIB supergravity on the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ quotient of $AdS_5 \times S^5$). Decide whether the bootstrap results agree with the holographic predictions.
artifact.category_tag: conformal bootstrap on real projective space
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has carried out exactly this program for $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM on $\mathbb{RP}^4$: a holographic dual via a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ quotient of $AdS_5\times S^5$ (with charge-conjugation gauging) has been constructed, and bootstrap techniques have been used to determine two-point functions of 1/2-BPS operators at leading order in the large central charge expansion, with agreement to holographic predictions. The Liouville theory side appears less developed in the literature. Thus the question is partially resolved for $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM but remains open for Liouville.

status_evidence.title: Holography for N=4 on RP^4
status_evidence.snippet: Holographic dual of N=4 SYM on RP^4 via Z_2 quotient of AdS_5 x S^5 with charge conjugation gauging.
status_evidence.claim: A holographic description for N=4 SYM on RP^4 has been constructed.

status_evidence.title: Correlators of N=4 SYM on Real Projective Space at Strong Coupling
status_evidence.snippet: Bootstrap techniques used to determine two-point functions of 1/2-BPS operators on RP^4 at leading order in large central charge, matched with type IIB supergravity.
status_evidence.claim: The RP^d bootstrap has been extended to strongly coupled N=4 SYM with agreement to holographic predictions.
